name: end_sitting
description: End this sitting after leaving a handoff in notes/journal.md. A sitting with no new paint and successful whole-canvas and detail looks in normal color completes the painting. Otherwise this call waits through the configured break and returns the next sitting's number, clock, journal and a fresh whole-canvas look. status shows the sitting's time remaining. The break does not advance the painting's clock.

name: read
description: Read a file in this studio. PNG files return an image; other files return text.
